summary: Adds violation_error_code plumbing to BaseConstraint and forwards it to the ValidationError raise sites, which resolves the core request. But it omits updating deconstruct() and __eq__, so the new attribute is lost in migration serialization and two constraints differing only by code compare equal.

issues.description: deconstruct() is not updated to include violation_error_code, so the attribute is dropped from migration serialization; constraints reload without the custom code. Incomplete fix for a persisted field.
__eq__ not updated, so two constraints identical except for violation_error_code compare equal — breaks equality/change-detection semantics and can mask migration state changes.
self.violation_error_code = violation_error_code is assigned twice (top of __init__ and again lower). Redundant duplicate write.
The '# RemovedInDjango60Warning.' comment marking the deprecation block was replaced by the assignment, losing that marker; docstring/attribute documentation for the new param also not added.
